text: I'm sorry. I can't... go on without me.
Here. I found it in the bar, behind the till. Take it.
One more grenade. Don't ask me where it was hidden.
Right. I've shot foxes off the henhouse. These are bigger foxes.
Thank you. I'll carry it back to you when this is over.
Then I keep the bread knife. Stay close, I'm right behind you.
You came back. I ran. I ran out the front and kept running, and then I couldn't go any further.
There's soup on the hearth. Get warm first. Then you can tell us what fell out of the sky.
Hello? Is somebody there? I'm in the stable, behind the hay!
Over here! Please, in the stable. I'm not one of them!
Is that you, from the inn? I'm back here, by the stalls!
The front door! Out, all of you, out and up the road to the village!
